title: Waveforms and results of seismic attenuation in Sumatra subduction zone, Indonesia
description:
Datasets for the manuscript:

Styawan, Y., Kuo, C.-H., Huang, B.-S., Wen, K.-L., Haridhi, H. A., Sianipar, D., Characteristics of seismic attenuation in Sumatra subduction zone, Indonesia (submitted)

The attached files include:

1) 0.2 Hz Highpass filtered waveforms for Z and T components.

2) Results (α, event, station, t*, Q, corner frequency, Ω0, SNR, component (Z or T), category (forearc, mountain, or backarc), and Qp/Qs).

3) Additional data (information on events and stations).

4) site amplification factors (P and S of all stations in different α).
